_comment: Copy to config/inbox-accounts.json (or point BROKER_INBOX_ACCOUNTS at your file). accounts: account key -> {email, ledger, posture}, all three non-empty strings, plus optional kind (gmail, the default, or mail) and batch_size (integer 1..6, default 3 unseen Gmail messages per run). ledger = the seen-ledger JSONL path for connector-backed triage; records identify mail with id, gmail_id or message_id. posture = per-account triage rules appended verbatim to the worker's runtime brief. A missing default file = no accounts (every inbox spawn refuses, logged); an explicit BROKER_INBOX_ACCOUNTS that does not exist, or a malformed file, stops the broker. Only Gmail accounts need <INBOX_MCP_CONFIG_DIR>/<account>.json. kind=mail defaults to supplied snippets only, no ledger access. Optional mail_tool is an absolute operator-installed command path exposing only list/read <id>/archive <id> with JSON stdout (exit 2 unknown verb, 3 busy). Optional boolean allow_archive defaults false and adds archive only when true, with a mail_tool and archive-compatible posture. See docs/configuration.md.

personal.posture:
#### `personal`: user@example.test

**Primary inbox. Conservative posture (would-archive-only):** log intended archives as `would-archive-*` ledger verdicts and leave the mail in the inbox. On ANY doubt, leave + surface.

external.posture: Classify supplied mail snippets and notify the operator of actionable or uncertain items. Digest routine items. Recommend actions only; this mailbox cannot be read or changed by the worker.
